definition: definition: what it is, the meaning of the concept, terminology
intuition: intuition: why it works, an explanation in plain words, the idea behind it
formula: formula: the equation, mathematics, derivation, mathematical notation and maths
algorithm_step: algorithm: the steps of the procedure, how to compute it, pseudocode, method
example: example: a worked example with numbers, an illustration, a case
comparison: comparison: a table comparing methods, versus, differences, pros and cons
pitfall: pitfalls: common mistakes, limitations, caveats, what can go wrong
application: applications: real-world uses, where it is used in industry, practical use cases
history: history: origin, timeline, who invented it, background
